ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: Golf Tees Durable Bamboo Tees 50Pcs/100Pcs 100Pcs 3-1/4" Friendly Biodegradable Material Reduce Friction Side Spin More Stable
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Durable Bamboo Material

Crafted from durable bamboo, these golf tees offer longevity and resistance to wear and tear.

Side Spin

The side spin feature of these tees improves accuracy and consistency in shots.

Biodegradable

Made from biodegradable material, these tees are eco-friendly and reduce environmental impact.

Multiple Quantity Options

Available in packs of 50 and 100, these tees cater to both casual players and professionals.

Reduce Friction

Designed to minimize friction, these tees enhance ball stability and performance.
